description: This file contains functions and types for managing scheduled cron jobs, including creation, patching, validation, and execution logic within a scheduling system.

methods.name: resolveStableCronOffsetMs
methods.description: Calculates a stable offset for a cron job based on its ID and stagger interval, using a cache and SHA-256 digest.

methods.name: computeStaggeredCronNextRunAtMs
methods.description: Computes the next run time for a cron job with staggered scheduling, adjusting for per-job offset.

methods.name: computeStaggeredCronPreviousRunAtMs
methods.description: Computes the previous run time for a staggered cron job, matching the effective schedule.

methods.name: resolveEveryAnchorMs
methods.description: Determines the anchor point for 'every' schedule type, using provided or fallback values.

methods.name: assertSupportedJobSpec
methods.description: Validates that a cron job has supported session target and payload configurations.

methods.name: assertMainSessionAgentId
methods.description: Ensures that the agent ID is valid for main session target, matching the default agent ID.

methods.name: assertDeliverySupport
methods.description: Checks if delivery configuration is valid for the session target, especially for webhook mode.

methods.name: assertFailureDestinationSupport
methods.description: Validates failure destination configuration, especially for webhook mode.

methods.name: findJobOrThrow
methods.description: Finds a cron job by ID within the state store or throws an error if not found.

methods.name: isJobEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether a job is enabled, defaulting to true if undefined.

methods.name: computeJobNextRunAtMs
methods.description: Calculates the next scheduled run time for a job based on its schedule and state.

methods.name: computeJobPreviousRunAtMs
methods.description: Calculates the previous run time for a cron job.

methods.name: recordScheduleComputeError
methods.description: Records an error during schedule computation, auto-disabling the job after max errors.

methods.name: normalizeJobTickState
methods.description: Normalizes the job's state before ticking, handling stuck markers and schedule validation.

methods.name: walkSchedulableJobs
methods.description: Iterates over jobs, applying a function to each, with normalization.

methods.name: recomputeJobNextRunAtMs
methods.description: Recomputes the next run time for a job, handling errors and updating state.

methods.name: recomputeNextRuns
methods.description: Recomputes next run times for all due or missing jobs.

methods.name: recomputeNextRunsForMaintenance
methods.description: Performs maintenance to fix invalid or expired schedule states without advancing enabled jobs.

methods.name: nextWakeAtMs
methods.description: Returns the earliest next wake-up time among enabled jobs.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new cron job with computed schedule and initial state.

methods.name: applyJobPatch
methods.description: Applies a patch to an existing cron job, updating fields and re-validating.

methods.name: mergeCronPayload
methods.description: Merges a payload patch into an existing payload, handling different payload kinds.

methods.name: mergeCronDelivery
methods.description: Merges delivery configuration patches into existing delivery settings.

methods.name: mergeCronFailureAlert
methods.description: Merges failure alert configuration patches into existing settings.

methods.name: isJobDue
methods.description: Determines if a job is due to run based on its state and schedule.

methods.name: resolveJobPayloadTextForMain
methods.description: Returns the payload text for system event jobs, trimmed and validated.
